content.text:
I added the R key and `restart-btn`. The other keys were already there. I found nothing broken in earlier features.

- **Controls:** R starts a new game, even when paused or after game over. Holding down P or R does nothing extra, and shortcuts like Cmd+R still reach the browser. I kept the old Shift (hold) and Esc (pause) keys, and added "R new game" to the on-screen key list.
- **Check:** the only standing check (line scores) was green on its last run. Otherwise this rests on reading the code and a script syntax check. I didn't play the game in a browser.
- **Open items:** REQ-002 and REQ-008 are still open, and REQ-001 and REQ-005 are partial. I couldn't see their full text, so I didn't change anything for them.
